newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour MP McMaster dies - government.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour MP McMaster dies - government.

text.p: Labour member of parliament Gordon McMaster has died, a spokeswoman for Prime Minister Tony Blair's office said on Monday.

McMaster, MP for the safe Labour seat of Paisley South, had a majority of 12,750 votes at the May 1 election. The spokeswoman said she had no further details but a statement was expected later by Scottish Secretary Donald Dewar.
McMaster's death leaves the Labour government with a 179-seat majority in the lower House of Commons, the parliamentary library said. McMaster was 37.
A by-election takes place this Thursday in the constituency of Uxbridge following the death soon after the May 1 election of the sitting Conservative MP.
